test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. She hugged my mom and almost screamed when she saw me.

B. It was a long ride before we finally reached.

C. A plump, over excited woman greeted us at the door.

D. Apparently, she had seen me as a baby and behaved as if she didn’t expect me to grow up!
solution:
The correct answer is 'BCAD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual__ connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

__
 
• Sentence B is the independent sentence and simply talks about a long ride which took the subjects (we) to their final destination. 
 
• So, sentence B is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• Sentence C describes who(a woman) greeted the subjects when they finally reached. Hence, C follows B.__
 
• Sentence A which explains how the woman greeted the subjects should come after sentence C, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• Sentence D is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides further information regarding the author's thoughts about the woman who greeted them. .

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 3 i.e. BCAD.

So, the correct paragraph is : *(B)* ***It was a long ride before we finally reached. (C) A plump, over excited woman greeted us at the door. (A) She hugged my mom and almost screamed when she saw me. (D) Apparently, she had seen me as a baby and behaved as if she didn’t expect me to grow up!***
